title: Give a function information
instructions_md:
## Parameters

A **parameter** is a name inside the brackets of a function. Each call gives it a value.

```python
def label(owner):
    print(f"This book belongs to {owner}.")

label("Mariam")
label("Ali")
```

```text
This book belongs to Mariam.
This book belongs to Ali.
```

## Your task

Define `invite(name, day)`. It prints one line like this:

`Lina, come on Sunday.`
hints: The function takes two values, separated by a comma.
Use an f-string with both parameters.
Write `def invite(name, day):` and print the sentence inside it.
solution_code:
def invite(name, day):
    print(f"{name}, come on {day}.")

wrong_answers.label: prints fixed values
wrong_answers.code:
def invite(name, day):
    print("Lina, come on Sunday.")

wrong_answers.label: swaps the two values
wrong_answers.code:
def invite(name, day):
    print(f"{day}, come on {name}.")

tests.name: Works for another name and day
tests.hint: Use the parameters, not fixed words.
